expects.query:
Deploy AMC on {{platform}}, using the `/vss-generate-video-calibration` skill end-to-end and autonomously.

**Environment & prerequisites:** A GPU host matching `{{platform}}` with Docker + NVIDIA container toolkit + `NGC_CLI_API_KEY`. The `/vss-generate-video-calibration` skill handles both deployment (`references/deploy-auto-calibration-service.md`) and calibration (`references/{videos,rtsp,sample-dataset}.md`) and runs the AMC platform preflight before deploy/capture/upload/calibration work. Deploy expects in this spec bring up `vss-auto-calibration` (MS, host-published on `${VSS_AUTO_CALIBRATION_HOST_PORT:-8010}`) and `vss-auto-calibration-ui` (UI on `${VSS_AUTO_CALIBRATION_UI_HOST_PORT:-5000}`) from the `vss-core` namespace on `nvcr.io` (org per the auto-calibration compose files); calibration expects then run against that running stack. AMC uses the `warehouse-operations` env layers: checked-in stable `.env`, checked-in `overrides.env` template, and active `generated.env`. Standalone AMC selects `COMPOSE_PROFILES=vss-auto-calibration,vss-auto-calibration-ui`; warehouse RTSP calibration sets `MODE=auto-calibration`, `BP_PROFILE=bp_wh_auto_calib`, and the single `COMPOSE_PROFILES=${COMPOSE_PROFILES_WH_AUTO_CALIB}` list (there are no per-mode `_2D`/`_3D`/`_MV3DT` variants). Project state mounts from `$VSS_APPS_DIR/services/auto-calibration/projects`; optional VGGT model mounts from `$VSS_DATA_DIR/auto-calib/vggt`. For RTSP-mode expects, the warehouse auto-calibration service list includes VIOS, so it responds at `http://localhost:30888/vst/api/v1/sensor/list` and `VIOS_BASE_URL` is auto-wired. For videos-mode expects, the test fixture provides `cam_00.mp4` … `cam_03.mp4` under `${VIDEO_DIR}` (defaults to `/data/videos/`) plus `alignment_data.json`, `layout.png`, and `GT.zip` under `/data/alignment/`. For sample-dataset-mode expects, `sdg_08_2_sample_data_010926.zip` is present at `assets/`.
checks: The skill loaded `references/deploy-auto-calibration-service.md` (the `deploy` mode), ran Step 0 platform preflight before NGC/image/compose work, and would stop to ask for existing/generated calibration artifacts or a supported calibration host if the preflight failed
`grep -q '^COMPOSE_PROFILES=vss-auto-calibration,vss-auto-calibration-ui$' $REPO_ROOT/deploy/docker/industry-profiles/warehouse-operations/generated.env` returns exit 0
`curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:$(grep ^VSS_AUTO_CALIBRATION_HOST_PORT $REPO_ROOT/deploy/docker/industry-profiles/warehouse-operations/generated.env | cut -d= -f2)/v1/ready` returns exit 0

`curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:$(grep ^VSS_AUTO_CALIBRATION_HOST_PORT $REPO_ROOT/deploy/docker/industry-profiles/warehouse-operations/generated.env | cut -d= -f2)/v1/ready` body matches `"code":0`

`curl -sf -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 15 http://localhost:$(grep ^VSS_AUTO_CALIBRATION_UI_HOST_PORT $REPO_ROOT/deploy/docker/industry-profiles/warehouse-operations/generated.env | cut -d= -f2)/` returns 200
`docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx vss-auto-calibration` returns exit 0
`docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx vss-auto-calibration-ui` returns exit 0
`docker inspect --format '{{.State.Health.Status}}' vss-auto-calibration` returns `healthy`

expects.query: Plan only; do not run commands, start containers, call AMC APIs, download data, or modify files. The user asks to launch AMC if needed and run the bundled sample calibration test. The automated check does not provide the sample zip, so describe the exact end-to-end sample workflow and prerequisites without claiming the zip exists. Include: use the AMC sample-dataset workflow; check whether AMC is already ready; use the deploy workflow only if AMC is not ready, while still running the AMC platform preflight before sample upload/calibration; if preflight fails, stop and request existing/generated calibration artifacts or a supported calibration host; require sample zip at assets/sdg_08_2_sample_data_010926.zip; extract idempotently into assets/.cache/sdg_08_2_sample_data_010926/; confirm GET /v1/ready returns code == 0 before uploads; upload four sorted sample videos, then alignment_data.json, then layout.png, then GT.zip; stage confirmed-linear sample media with POST /v1/linear_media and require rectification_state == COMPLETED; verify project_state == READY; start or resume VGGT when available and post-process every completed VGGT run; start AMC with detector_type resnet, poll amc_state, then post-process again; fetch both methods' available evaluation_statistics; compare metrics and overlays; and say the final report after execution will include project_id, UI URL, and sample metrics. Do not write helper scripts into the repo and do not print secrets.
checks: The plan uses the AMC sample-dataset workflow, checks whether AMC is already ready, and uses the deploy workflow only when deployment is needed while still including the shared platform preflight and failure path.
The plan requires the sample zip or an explicitly obtained sample zip before the sample run and extracts it idempotently before upload.
The plan confirms /v1/ready returns code == 0 before uploads, then uploads four sorted cam_*.mp4 files plus alignment_data.json, layout.png, and GT.zip before project verification.

The plan stages confirmed-linear sample media and requires rectification_state == COMPLETED, verifies project_state == READY, starts or resumes VGGT and post-processes every completed VGGT run before sample AMC calibration, polls amc_state, post-processes again, fetches both methods' available statistics, and compares metrics and overlays.
The plan says the final report after execution includes project ID, UI URL, and sample metrics, and does not print bearer tokens, NGC keys, HuggingFace tokens, or other secret values.

expects.query: Plan only; do not run commands, start containers, call AMC APIs, capture video, or modify files. The user has three RTSP streams and wants to calibrate them with AMC. Return a detailed ordered RTSP calibration plan. Include: use the AMC RTSP workflow in `references/rtsp.md` through `vss-generate-video-calibration`; run the AMC platform preflight before VIOS probing, capture, upload, or calibration; if preflight fails, stop and request existing/generated calibration artifacts or a supported calibration host; only after preflight passes, check VIOS availability and `VIOS_BASE_URL`, and route to `vss-manage-video-io-storage` only if VIOS must be brought up or repaired; preserve the ordered RTSP stream list; create the AMC project; call `POST /v1/rtsp/capture/<project_id>` with a 60–1200 second duration; poll automatic ingest until `INGESTED` without a manual ingest endpoint; upload or verify `alignment_data.json` and `layout.png`; verify `project_state == READY`; start or resume VGGT, post-process every completed VGGT run, then run AMC, poll `amc_state`, post-process again, and compare both methods' available metrics and overlays; preserve AMC error output on failure.
checks: The plan uses the AMC RTSP calibration workflow through vss-generate-video-calibration, not the local-video or sample workflow.

The plan includes the AMC platform preflight before VIOS probing, capture, upload, or calibration work and says preflight failure stops the flow to request existing/generated calibration artifacts or a supported calibration host.
The plan checks VIOS availability and VIOS_BASE_URL before capture and routes to vss-manage-video-io-storage only if VIOS needs to be brought up or repaired.

The plan preserves the ordered RTSP stream list, polls automatic ingest until INGESTED, uploads/verifies alignment and layout assets, explicitly stages confirmed linear media or completes UI rectification before verification, verifies project_state == READY, starts or resumes VGGT then runs AMC, post-processes after each completed calibration, compares results, and preserves AMC error output on failure.
